name: The Basantapur Railing
description: A grand staircase railing built around flowing spirals that curl and unfurl like a river bend. Made in Nepal, for Nepali homes that want a staircase people stop to admire.
material: 10mm MS rod (hand-forged scroll), 1"x1" MS pipe frame, 1" MS flat bar (patti)
